metadata.name: Engineering Asset Standard
metadata.description: Baseline compliance schema for engineering assets. Requires ownership, classification and lifecycle metadata, and places every engineering asset within an assembly hierarchy.

description: Requires owner, classification and retention metadata for all engineering assets and a parent assembly link.

checks.name: baseline-fields-present
checks.description: The default asset metadata schema's required fields are present and typed as declared, and the asset names its owner, classification level and retention period.

checks.name: review-fields-present
checks.description: The owning department and the next scheduled review date are recorded.

checks.name: has-parent-assembly
checks.description: The asset belongs to at least one parent assembly.
